name: react-native-to-swiftui
description: Plan and port one bounded React Native or Expo feature slice to SwiftUI with parity evidence and iOS readiness checks.

interface.shortDescription: Port one approved native iOS slice safely.
interface.longDescription: A contract-first workflow for bounded React Native and Expo modernization. Inspect only declared source, write a behavioral parity contract, port one explicitly approved slice into a declared SwiftUI target, keep domain logic pure Swift, verify deterministic behavior, and preflight iOS release readiness without promising App Store approval.
defaultPrompt: Use $plan-react-native-port to inspect only the declared React Native feature and propose a SwiftUI parity contract. Do not edit files yet.
Use $port-react-native-slice to port one explicitly approved feature slice into my declared SwiftUI target directory.
Use $verify-swiftui-parity to check the approved SwiftUI slice against its behavioral parity contract.
Use $audit-ios-readiness to run a read-only App Store-readiness preflight for my declared iOS target.
